title: New to xDrip
body:
I am trying xDrip on an Android 10 smart phone and was able to get it to work fairly easily.  Thank-you!
Two questions:
1)  Will the sensors just stop working at ten days and/or is there some sort of notification?  
2)  Same issue regarding the transmitter itself.  Will it just cease to work or is there some sort of notification end-of-life is near?

comments.body:
1. No it will not stop working after 10 days, it will die when the battery is out and you will not get any notifications about it, but you should as always change to a new after 10 days has passed.

2. It depends, if you have Miaomiao 1/2 you can set the system to alert you when it less than 20% battery left.

@wntrmute2 Would you please close this issue if your questions were answered?
You can always ask in the facebook group or the Gitter room.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
